title: fix(ui): keep compact sidebar submenu actions reachable
body:
| Solid 2 checklist in touched production family | Before | After | Retained contract |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 1. Unstable intrinsic handlers | 0 | 0 | Existing handlers dispatch through current item props. |
| 2. Component-level `onCleanup` | 0 | 0 | One cleanup remains inside the `createMenuControls` ref factory primitive. |
| 3. Hand-rolled async reads | 0 | 0 | No data reads in this change. |
| 4. Hand-rolled mutations | 0 | 0 | No Gateway mutation in this change. |
| 5. Manual import loaders | 0 | 0 | Existing lazy menu-body preparation is native focus scheduling, not an import loader. |
| 6. Immutable object/array signals | 0 | 0 | Existing signal is a numeric preparation limit. |
| 7. Hand-written `createComponent` | 0 | 0 | Existing dynamic item component remains JSX. |
| 8. Throw-only context wrappers | 0 | 0 | None. |
| 9. Uncoordinated sibling Loading | 0 | 0 | None. |
| 10. Manual owner roots | 0 | 0 | None. |

## What Problem This Solves

Nested menus lost the vertical end alignment of a side-opening parent. In the compact sidebar identity menu, a long Gateway submenu consequently used the smaller space below its trigger and clipped Gateway settings despite enough room above.

## User Impact

Users can reach Gateway settings from the compact sidebar even when the submenu opens near the bottom of the window. Existing mobile menu behavior stays the same.

## Why This Change Was Made

Forward side-end placement to each nested Menu, choosing the side from its text direction. A plain accessor keeps the compiler from allocating a conditional memo when the anchor reads the placement in `onSettled`. Keep top/bottom placement behavior, CSS anchor flipping, height limits, existing classes, and the shared menu lifecycle unchanged.

## Evidence

| Proof | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Before regression | LTR right, LTR horizontal flip, RTL left all fail at the intended assertion: content height 294 px exceeds visible height 171 px. |
| Changed native-contract browser file | 28 passed across Chromium and WebKit, including all six new geometry cases. |
| UI typecheck | `pnpm tsgo:ui` passed on final source. |
| Production Knip | Reports three unused unchanged files: `src/cron/heartbeat-monitor.ts`, `src/cron/system-monitor-jobs.ts`, `src/gateway/server-cron-system-jobs.ts`. The exact same findings occur at baseline `ec437b3c9580ce53fa86523d7ee731b488458e88`. Package/lock/workspace files, Knip configuration and its direct helpers, and all three reported files have identical blobs at that baseline, this PR base `6ca8c33832da`, and this head. No ignores added. |
| Paired production build / strict performance | Passed, with no violations or warnings. Startup JS: 323,762 → 323,772 B gzip (+10); chat boot: 1,497,302 → 1,497,385 B (+83); new-session boot: 1,019,390 → 1,019,462 B (+72). All remain below 325,000 / 1,500,000 / 1,035,000 B caps. Startup stays at 8 JS / 1 CSS request; startup CSS is unchanged at 40,501 B. |
| Synthetic visual capture | Before/after inspected at 1280×900 and 390×500 using nine synthetic Gateways; no page errors. Desktop settings row goes from clipped to fully visible; mobile remains reachable. Artifact-only Playwright capture uses Node because its native browser harness requires it; ordinary browser tests use the pinned Bun runtime. |
| Full CI | [Run 39632969742](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39632969742) completed with two E2E failures listed below; the only other failed job is their downstream CI gate. |
| Independent review | Final P0–P2 autoreview completed scoped-clean, with no findings. Final source verification passed. |

Refactor checklist in `menu.tsx`: rendering controllers, effects, render effects, DOM listeners, DOM queries, class-string construction, owner APIs: **0 → 0** each; intentional initial snapshots (`untrack`): **2 → 2**; native focus commit (`flush`): **1 → 1**; primitive cleanup: **1 → 1**.

Production `menu.tsx`: 721 → 729 lines (+8); browser regression file: 407 → 465 (+58). The growth carries the inherited alignment accessor/prop and tests ordinary LTR opening, horizontal flipping, and RTL opening; no new state, shared abstraction, or dependency.

![Before: desktop Gateway settings is clipped](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6608c01-3c03-4725-8c0a-333896b8c8ac)

![After: desktop Gateway settings is fully reachable](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e164d047-0193-4163-88c1-12ead8e882d4)

![Before: mobile Gateway submenu](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/392d741c-f26b-4a50-827d-366a06bdb65d)

![After: mobile Gateway submenu remains reachable](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6dc6e7af-f5d4-422e-b4af-163f7a2010e9)

### Inherited CI failures

The exact names and assertion sites below also fail in the latest completed scheduled [main run 39626840495](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39626840495) at `ba99dfe79f32`. Native inherited-failure admission will retain the failed result.

- `Control UI agent page scope > scopes pages from the chip and keeps Agents settings independent`
- `Control UI native-nav sidebar toggle E2E > hosts navigation, search, sessions, and history in web titlebar chrome`

The navigation failure is the focused Inbox button’s `boxShadow` being `none` at line 351. The agent menu remains unanchored to its card at line 328; this patch only changes nested side-end submenu placement.
